title: Implement deterministic work-setting classification
description: Build on prepared SerpAPI inputs to classify Office, Hybrid, Remote, or Unknown. Office requires explicit onsite attendance without an established recurring remote arrangement; Hybrid requires recurring onsite plus remote work; Remote allows geography restrictions and occasional travel; Unknown covers missing, conflicting, conditional, or multiple-option evidence. Extract evidence separately from precedence. Role-specific attendance outranks generic WFH metadata or recruiter hashtags. Handle negation, technical hybrid cloud language, employer boilerplate, travel, temporal conditions, and multiple options. Preserve rule/evidence/confidence/conflict audit fields. No automatic warehouse deployment.
design: User directs all evidence rules and resolution into dbt/models/analysis/jobs_detail.sql, inline CTEs (no business-logic macros). Keep upstream layers limited to input preparation/passthrough. Validate production SQL with dbt unit/literal fixtures and read-only BigQuery checks; do not materialize models or deploy.
acceptance_criteria: Deterministic contextual rules and regression fixtures implemented and QA reviewed; absent WFH never implies Office; generic metadata cannot override explicit attendance; audit fields explain outcomes.
